$comment: A pull request's recording, as its recipe leaves it with --talk and without --discard: the board as main had it, the pull request branched from it with the change and a reviewer's walkthrough, and the talk of that walkthrough kept in the author's home. json is the standard library module, outside the checkout, so it is external and unbound. The talk is kept in the light theme; the request asks for the dark one.

nodes.responsibility:
dumps, loads and response
with Flask's JSON defaults

beats.heading: One object now decides how JSON is written
beats.body: Before this change, the helpers built JSON with encoder classes set on the app. Now the app holds a provider, and an application that replaces it changes JSON everywhere.

beats.heading: The app creates a DefaultJSONProvider
beats.body: The app makes the provider as app.json when it is created. Its dumps and loads call the standard json module with Flask's defaults.

beats.heading: The helpers delegate to the app's provider
beats.body: flask.json.dumps and loads call app.json when an app is active, and the json module when none is. Check that fallback: outside an app, no provider applies.
